{{CharInfobox |color={{sinnoh color}} |corecolor={{orange color light}} |bordercolor={{sinnoh color dark}} |name=Remo |jname=ルイ |tmname=Louie |caption=Remo |image=Remo XY.png |size=150px |gender=Male |trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Kalos]] |anime=yes |epnum=XYS01 |epname=Mega Evolution Special I |enva=[[Marc Thompson]] |java=[[Kōichi Yamadera]] }} '''Remo''' (Japanese: '''ルイ''' ''Louie'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}, and a [[rival]] of [[Alain]]. ==History== [[File:Remo Key Stone.png|thumb|left|250px|Remo's Key Stone]] Remo debuted in ''[[XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I]]''. He was sent to an assignment to retrieve a [[Mega Stone]] from ancient ruins by an unknown person, but as Alain found it first, Remo challenged him to a {{pkmn|battle}} over the Mega Stone. When Alain accepted his challenge, he introduced himself as a [[Type expert|Dragon Trainer]], and Alain responded that his partner, {{TP|Alain|Charizard}}, is a {{type|Dragon}} too. Remo pointed out that it was amateurish to call Charizard a Dragon type, but Alain simply shrugged this off, saying that Remo was the one being an amateur. After this, both Trainers [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] their Pokémon and engaged in a fierce battle, which eventually ended in Alain's victory. After winning, Alain told Remo that he should henceforth remember that Mega Charizard X is a {{2t|Fire|Dragon}} type. Remo made his animated series debut in ''[[XY125|A League of His Own!]]'', where he competed in the [[Lumiose Conference]]. During the opening reception, he was shown talking with [[Titus]] and [[Astrid]]. At the end of the episode, he was shown to have won his first battle and advanced to the second round. In ''[[XY126|Valuable Experience for All!]]'', he was shown to have made his way to the semifinals. Later, it was revealed that he would battle Alain in that round. Their battle took place in ''[[XY127|Analysis Versus Passion!]]'', where Remo lost to Alain, with the latter only needing two of his Pokémon to defeat Remo's full team. ==Character== Remo is shown to be a confident person, readily wanting to battle Alain upon discovering that he possesses a [[Key Stone]] and believing his Garchomp could defeat all of Alain's Pokémon during Remo's rematch with him during the Lumiose Conference. He also appears to be a bit of a show-off, bragging about his Garchomp's power and posing while introducing himself, as well as waving his umbrella around. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Remo's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Remo |img=Remo Garchoo.png |img2=Remo Mega Garchomp.png |cap2=Mega Garchoo |pkmn=Garchomp |gender=male |nick=Garchoo |mega=yes |type1=Dragon |type2=Ground |epnum=XYS01 |vajp=Shin-ichiro Miki |vaen=Shin-ichiro Miki |epname=Mega Evolution Special I |desc=Remo's main Pokémon is a male {{p|Garchomp}} [[nickname]]d '''Garchoo''' (Japanese: '''ガブの字''' ''Gabunoji''). He is able to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] into Mega Garchomp. Remo used him in a battle against Alain's Mega {{TP|Alain|Charizard}} X in [[XYS01|Mega Evolution Special I]] but eventually lost. In ''[[XY126|Valuable Experience for All!]]'', he appeared alongside his Trainer to compete in the [[Lumiose Conference]]. In one of the rounds, he was shown defeating a {{p|Hydreigon}}. In ''[[XY127|Analysis Versus Passion!]]'', he appeared in a rematch against Alain's Mega Charizard X in the semifinals of the Lumiose Conference but was defeated by Charizard's {{m|Dragon Claw}}. Garchoo's known moves are {{m|Dragon Rush}}, {{m|Dual Chop}}, {{m|Stone Edge}}, {{m|Draco Meteor}}, and {{m|Dragon Claw}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Remo |pkmn=Rhyperior |img=Remo Rhypo.png |nick=Rhypo |type1=Ground |type2=Rock |vajp=Tsuguo Mogami |vaen=Marc Thompson |epnum=XY127 |epname=Analysis Versus Passion! |desc=Remo used his {{p|Rhyperior}}, [[nickname]]d '''Rhypo''' (Japanese: '''ドドすけ''' ''Dodosuke''), against [[Alain]] in the [[Lumiose Conference]]. It was defeated by a {{m|Dragon Claw}} attack from [[Alain's Charizard]] despite the massive type advantage. None of Rhypo's moves are known.}} ===Scoreboard Pokémon=== Remo was shown to have these Pokémon briefly on the scoreboard during the Lumiose Conference.
